The outcome of one check

Source: R/result.R
check_result.Rd

flag is "OK", "NOT_APPLICABLE" (skipped, with the reason in detail), "CHECK_ERROR" (the check raised an error), or a check-specific risk string such as "SPLIT_OVERLAP_RISK". Anything other than the first two counts as a finding.

Usage

check_result(
  check_name,
  category,
  flag,
  detail = "",
  blocking = TRUE,
  metadata = list(),
  duration_ms = NA_real_
)

Arguments

check_name, category, flag, detail

Strings.

blocking

TRUE if a finding must stop the deploy, FALSE if it only routes to human review.

metadata

Named list of values behind the finding.

duration_ms

Filled in by run_gate().

Value

An object of class check_result.

Examples

r <- check_result("my_check", "validation", "OK", detail = "nothing to report")
r$flag
#> [1] "OK"
